owner: Dr Rosanna Fasciani, Dr Nahim Ali and Dr Corcoran
summary: A Mississauga family practice with three named dentists and an accessible office is a strength, but a booking form with no visible submit button and mixed team links appear to cost you new patients.

findings.problem: The appointment form appears to show raw dropdown text ('Preferred Time - None - MorningAfternoon') and no visible submit button.
findings.cost: A new patient who tries to request an appointment may not know how to finish.
findings.fix: A clean booking form with a visible button and confirmation.

findings.problem: The main menu appears to link to /meet-our-mississauga-team while the body links to /meet-our-team, and the carousel Previous and Next buttons appear to point to the same anchor.
findings.cost: Patients may land on a broken page or a carousel that does not move.
findings.fix: One correct team page and working carousel controls.

findings.problem: The Google Maps link in the header appears to end in a stray '6', and Friday hours appear in a different format from the other days.
findings.cost: A broken map link and mixed hours cost patients who come to find you.
findings.fix: A correct map link and one hours format.

findings.problem: Only one unattributed testimonial appears with no ratings or review count, and Dr Corcoran appears with no first name.
findings.cost: Thin proof and half named staff weaken trust for a new patient.
findings.fix: Named reviews with ratings and full dentist profiles.

redesign: One team page and working controls.
A correct map link, one hours format and visible proof.
